SELECT
  (g.grid_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') as time,
  COALESCE(al.duration_seconds, 60) as "持续秒数",
  COALESCE(al.state, '📴 关机离线 (未通电/无数据)') as "全盘宏观状态"
FROM (
  -- 1. 活体骨架层：自适应分桶时间骨架，最大像素宽度限额 ~2000，解决长范围时间轴下卡死问题
  SELECT generate_series(
    $__timeFrom()::timestamptz,
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz,
    GREATEST(interval '1 minute', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz)) / 2000)::int))
  ) AS grid_time
) g
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  -- 2. 局部快速寻址：利用 start_time 上的 B-Tree 索引，以 O(log N) 级反向检索覆盖该网格点的状态
  SELECT 
    duration_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN process_name = 'System_Sleep' THEN '⬛ 绝对睡眠 (风扇停转)'
      WHEN process_name IN ('System_DisplayOff', 'LockApp.exe') THEN '🟥 屏幕关闭 (伪睡眠/锁屏)'
      WHEN process_name IN ('System_Idle', 'Idle') THEN '🟡 键鼠静止 (人不在暂离)'
      ELSE '🟢 深度工作 (正常使用中)'
    END as state
  FROM app_usage_logs
  WHERE start_time <= g.grid_time 
    AND start_time >= g.grid_time - interval '24 hours' -- 索引范围收敛
    AND start_time + (duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval > g.grid_time
  ORDER BY start_time DESC
  LIMIT 1
) al ON true
ORDER BY time ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  AVG(current_fps) AS "全局实时帧率",
  AVG(average_fps) AS "全局平均帧率",
  MIN(one_percent_low_fps) AS "1% Low 瞬时低帧率",
  MAX(frametime_ms) AS "单帧渲染时间"
FROM public.fact_system_hardware
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("timestamp", $__interval),
  -- 聚合每 3 秒内最大的帧时抖动，精准捕捉瞬时微观撕裂
  MAX(frametime_jitter) AS "帧时微观抖动率"
FROM public.fact_system_hardware
WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp")
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

),
time_grid AS (
  -- 1.1 动态确定在当前过滤时间段内有实际数据的时间边界
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, MIN(timestamp)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS range_start,
    COALESCE(LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, MAX(timestamp)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS range_end
  FROM public.fact_process_context
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
grid_mapped AS (
  -- 1.2 活体骨架层：在有数据的局部时间范围内自适应采样，上限 2000 点，大幅提升采样精度
  SELECT
    g.grid_time,
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label
  FROM (
    SELECT generate_series(
      b.range_start,
      b.range_end,
      GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.range_end - b.range_start)) / 2000)::int))
    ) AS grid_time
    FROM time_grid b
  ) g
  -- a. 快速检索前台聚焦进程
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ctx.process_key, ctx.end_timestamp
    FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
    WHERE ctx.timestamp <= g.grid_time
      AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    ORDER BY ctx.timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) ctx_match ON true
  -- b. 获取进程维度名称
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx_match.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  -- c. 快速检查 Away 状态 (利用 AHK 日志 start_time 索引)
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 1 AS is_away
    FROM public.app_usage_logs a
    WHERE a.start_time <= g.grid_time
      AND a.start_time >= g.grid_time - interval '24 hours' -- 索引范围收敛
      AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval > g.grid_time
      AND a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    LIMIT 1
  ) away ON true
  WHERE away.is_away IS NULL
    AND (ctx_match.end_timestamp > g.grid_time OR ctx_match.end_timestamp IS NULL)
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
),
process_analytics AS (
  -- 3. Top15：直接按数据库中的真实前台时间总和排名，避免采样偏差导致前台应用展示缺失或排名错误
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name)) AS usage_rank
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  WHERE ctx.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND ctx.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC
  LIMIT 15
),
final_stream AS (
  -- 4. 分发层：锁定前台活跃总时间最长的前 15 个应用
  SELECT gm.grid_time AS time,
    lpad(pa.usage_rank::text, 2, '0') || ' · ' || gm.app_label AS metric,
    1 AS value
  FROM grid_mapped gm
  JOIN process_analytics pa ON gm.app_label = pa.app_label
)
SELECT time, metric, value FROM final_stream
ORDER BY time ASC;

WITH time_bounds AS (
  -- 1.1 动态确定在当前过滤时间段内有实际 data 的时间边界
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, MIN(timestamp)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS range_start,
    COALESCE(LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, MAX(timestamp)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS range_end
  FROM public.fact_process_context
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
time_grid AS (
  -- 1.2 活体骨架层：在有数据的局部时间范围内自适应采样，上限 2000 点，大幅提升时序精度
  SELECT generate_series(
    b.range_start,
    b.range_end,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.range_end - b.range_start)) / 2000)::int))
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
)
SELECT 
  g.grid_time AS "time",
  act.proc_cpu_usage AS "前台 CPU 占用率 (%)",
  act.proc_gpu_usage AS "前台 GPU 占用率 (%)",
  act.proc_ram_mb / 1024.0 AS "前台 内存占用 (GB)",
  act.proc_vram_used_gb AS "前台 显存占用 (GB)"
FROM time_grid g
-- 2. 局部快速寻址：利用索引定位前台聚焦上下文
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ctx.process_key, ctx.os_pid, ctx.end_timestamp
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  WHERE ctx.timestamp <= g.grid_time
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
  ORDER BY ctx.timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) ctx_match ON true
-- 3. 局部快速检索瞬时指标（利用索引定位最接近网格点且在 15 秒内的活动记录）
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT act.proc_cpu_usage, act.proc_gpu_usage, act.proc_ram_mb, act.proc_vram_used_gb
  FROM public.fact_process_activity act
  WHERE act.timestamp <= g.grid_time 
    AND act.timestamp >= g.grid_time - interval '15 seconds'
    AND act.process_key = ctx_match.process_key 
    AND act.os_pid = ctx_match.os_pid
  ORDER BY act.timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
) act ON true
-- 4. 快速检查 Away 状态 (利用 AHK 日志 start_time 索引)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT 1 AS is_away
  FROM public.app_usage_logs a
  WHERE a.start_time <= g.grid_time
    AND a.start_time >= g.grid_time - interval '24 hours' -- 索引范围收敛
    AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval > g.grid_time
    AND a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
  LIMIT 1
) away ON true
WHERE away.is_away IS NULL
  AND (ctx_match.end_timestamp > g.grid_time OR ctx_match.end_timestamp IS NULL)
ORDER BY time ASC;

    ('frostpunk2.exe', '❄️ 冰汽时代 2'),
    ('masterduel.exe', '🃏 游戏王：决斗大师')
),
active_frames AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    hw.current_fps,
    hw.frametime_ms
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware hw
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ctx.process_key, ctx.os_pid, ctx.end_timestamp
    FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
    WHERE ctx.timestamp <= hw.timestamp
      AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    ORDER BY ctx.timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) ctx_match ON true
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx_match.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 1 AS is_away
    FROM public.app_usage_logs a
    WHERE a.start_time <= hw.timestamp
      AND a.start_time >= hw.timestamp - interval '24 hours' -- 索引范围收敛
      AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval > hw.timestamp
      AND a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    LIMIT 1
  ) away ON true
  WHERE away.is_away IS NULL
    AND hw.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND hw.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hw.timestamp)::bigint % 30) < 3  -- 30秒稀疏降采样
    AND (ctx_match.end_timestamp > hw.timestamp OR ctx_match.end_timestamp IS NULL)
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',

SELECT

  ROUND(AVG(current_fps)::numeric, 1) AS "平均帧率 (FPS)",
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY current_fps)::numeric, 1) AS "10% 低帧率",
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN frametime_ms >= 50.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*))::numeric, 2) || '%' AS "卡顿率 (FT >= 50ms)",
  ROUND((COUNT(*) * 30.0 / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS "前台运行时长 (分钟)"
FROM active_frames
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

time_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, MIN(timestamp)), $__timeFrom()::timestamptz) AS range_start,
    COALESCE(LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, MAX(timestamp)), $__timeTo()::timestamptz) AS range_end
  FROM public.fact_system_hardware
  WHERE timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
),
time_grid AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    b.range_start,
    b.range_end,
    GREATEST(interval '3 seconds', make_interval(secs => ceil(extract(epoch from (b.range_end - b.range_start)) / 2000)::int))
  ) AS grid_time
  FROM time_bounds b
),
grid_mapped AS (
  SELECT
    g.grid_time,
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    hw.cpu_total_usage,
    hw.gpu_usage,
    away.is_away
  FROM time_grid g
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ctx.process_key, ctx.os_pid, ctx.end_timestamp
    FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
    WHERE ctx.timestamp <= g.grid_time
      AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    ORDER BY ctx.timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) ctx_match ON true
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx_match.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT hw.cpu_total_usage, hw.gpu_usage
    FROM public.fact_system_hardware hw
    WHERE hw.timestamp <= g.grid_time 
      AND hw.timestamp >= g.grid_time - interval '15 seconds'
    ORDER BY hw.timestamp DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) hw ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 1 AS is_away
    FROM public.app_usage_logs a
    WHERE a.start_time <= g.grid_time
      AND a.start_time >= g.grid_time - interval '24 hours' -- 索引范围收敛
      AND a.start_time + (a.duration_seconds || ' seconds')::interval > g.grid_time
      AND a.process_name IN ('System_Sleep','System_DisplayOff','System_Idle','Idle','System_LockScreen','LockApp.exe')
    LIMIT 1
  ) away ON true
  WHERE (ctx_match.end_timestamp > g.grid_time OR ctx_match.end_timestamp IS NULL)
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
),
process_analytics AS (
  -- 统一按真实聚焦时长做 Top15 排名，保证卡顿打点、前台活动及资源瓶颈完全横向对齐
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name) AS app_label,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC, COALESCE(pm.alias_name, '⚙️ ' || reg.process_name)) AS usage_rank
  FROM public.fact_process_context ctx
  JOIN public.dim_process_registry reg ON ctx.process_key = reg.process_key
  LEFT JOIN process_map pm ON LOWER(reg.process_name) = pm.proc_name
  WHERE ctx.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()::timestamptz
    AND ctx.timestamp <= $__timeTo()::timestamptz
    AND ctx.is_foreground = 1
    AND LOWER(reg.process_name) NOT IN (
      'searchhost.exe', 'startmenuexperiencehost.exe', 'openwith.exe',
      'lockapp.exe', 'inno_updater.exe', 'steamwebhelper.exe',
      'tagtunnel.exe', 'xlliveud.exe', 'gameinputsvc.exe'
    )
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ctx.duration_ms, 0)) DESC
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT 
  gm.grid_time AS time,
  lpad(pa.usage_rank::text, 2, '0') || ' · ' || gm.app_label AS metric,
  CASE 
    WHEN gm.is_away IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN gm.cpu_total_usage IS NULL OR gm.gpu_usage IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN gm.gpu_usage >= 90.0 THEN 2
    WHEN gm.cpu_total_usage >= 80.0 AND gm.gpu_usage < 80.0 THEN 3
    ELSE 1
  END AS value
FROM grid_mapped gm
JOIN process_analytics pa ON gm.app_label = pa.app_label
ORDER BY time ASC;
